title: IBM, Together AI ink $240 million deal for Nvidia-powered AI inference cluster
excerpt: IBM and startup Together AI have signed a $240 million multi-year agreement to ‌build a large-scale artificial intelligence cluster on IBM Cloud ‌using Nvidi...
content_html:
Anhata Rooprai

Tue, August 11, 2026 at 7:02 AM CDT 1 min read

By Anhata Rooprai

Aug 11 (Reuters) - IBM and startup Together AI have signed a $240 million multi-year agreement to ‌build a large-scale artificial intelligence cluster on IBM Cloud ‌using Nvidia systems, the companies said on Tuesday.

The cluster will provide inference ​for open-source AI models, which have gained traction as businesses seek to rein in AI costs and weigh concerns about cybersecurity incidents involving models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Meta.

Inference, the process ‌of running trained ⁠AI models to generate responses, has become one of the largest drivers of demand for computing ⁠capacity, prompting cloud providers and chipmakers to spend billions of dollars expanding AI infrastructure.

The cluster on IBM Cloud will use Nvidia's ​HGX ​B300 systems, which link the ​chipmaker's newer Blackwell processors, and ‌its Spectrum-X Ethernet networking gear. Nvidia has said the Blackwell chips are optimized for AI inference.

The initial cluster will feature about 2,000 Nvidia Blackwell 300 chips and will be located in the U.S., Together AI's chief revenue officer Kai ‌Mak told Reuters in an interview.

"We ​think this will be sold out ​at least two to ​three months ahead of time," Mak added. "We'll ‌have full offtake well before it's ​ready for ​service."

San Francisco-based Together AI's platform lets companies train and run AI workloads on open models such as DeepSeek, MiniMax ​and Kimi at ‌lower costs than closed systems. It was last ​valued at $8.3 billion in July.

(Reporting by Anhata Rooprai in ​Bengaluru; Editing by Tasim Zahid)

content_html_zh:
安哈塔·鲁普赖

2026 年 8 月 11 日星期二上午 7:02 CDT 阅读时间 1 分钟

作者：安哈塔·鲁普莱

路透 8 月 11 日 - IBM 和初创公司 Together AI 周二表示，已签署一项价值 2.4 亿美元的多年期协议，将使用 Nvidia 系统在 IBM Cloud 上构建一个大规模人工智能集群。

该集群将为开源人工智能模型提供推理，随着企业寻求控制人工智能成本并权衡涉及 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Meta 模型的网络安全事件的担忧，开源人工智能模型已获得关注。

推理，即运行训练有素的 AI 模型来生成响应的过程，已成为计算能力需求的最大驱动因素之一，促使云提供商和芯片制造商花费数十亿美元扩展 AI 基础设施。

IBM Cloud 上的集群将使用 Nvidia 的 HGX B300 系统，该系统连接该芯片制造商的较新 Blackwell 处理器及其 Spectrum-X 以太网网络设备。 英伟达表示 Blackwell 芯片针对人工智能推理进行了优化。

Together AI 首席营收官 Kai Mak 在接受路透社采访时表示，最初的集群将配备约 2,000 个 Nvidia Blackwell 300 芯片，并将位于美国。

“我们认为这将至少提前两到三个月售空，”麦补充道。 “我们将在准备投入使用之前就完成全部承购。”

总部位于旧金山的 Together AI 平台让公司能够在 DeepSeek、MiniMax 和 Kimi 等开放模型上训练和运行人工智能工作负载，且成本比封闭系统更低。 最后一次估值是在 7 月份，为 83 亿美元。

（Anhata Rooprai 班加罗尔报道；Tasim Zahid 编辑）
